page_title: SEV 4-1 BAR | Sevilla v Barcelona 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+10' The match has just finished.
90+8' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+8' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+7' Akor Adams (Sevilla) picks up a caution.
90+6' 4 - 1 Goal! Chidera Ejuke puts the ball on a plate for Akor Adams (Sevilla), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 4:1.
90+5' Here comes the VAR decision and Peque (Sevilla) is back in the game after the red card is downgraded to a yellow!

90+3' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Peque (Sevilla), but referee Alejandro Ruiz must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+3' Peque (Sevilla) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
90+3' Here is a change. Alexis Sanchez is going off and Matias Almeyda gives the last tactical orders to Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 3 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.

89' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Odysseas Vlachodimos makes a great save to stop his effort.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Frenkie de Jong leaves the pitch and Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) comes on.
87' A goal, which was scored by Akor Adams (Sevilla), was disallowed due to offside.
85' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) picks up a long through ball, but Odysseas Vlachodimos deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
84' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
76' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly wide of the left post.
75' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' Referee Alejandro Ruiz is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Barcelona!
74' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Barcelona as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
74' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
74' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Ruiz signals a set piece. PENALTY to Barcelona! Great chance to score.
73' Substitution. Batista Mendy is replaced by Peque (Sevilla).
73' Matias Almeyda has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) replacing Ruben Vargas.
71' The attendance is 41040.
69' We are about to witness a substitution. Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) is replacing Ferran Torres.
68' Pedri (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Odysseas Vlachodimos, who smothers the ball.
68' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

68' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
67' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
66' The ball is cleared after Akor Adams (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Sevilla force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

64' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
64' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

64' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Odysseas Vlachodimos makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Barcelona.
63' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
61' Matias Almeyda has decided to make a change. Akor Adams (Sevilla) replaces Isaac Romero.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is brought on as a substitute for Djibril Sow.
60' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
57' The Sevilla players can’t believe it after referee Alejandro Ruiz signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

57' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Sevilla.
57' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
56' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Wojciech Szczesny.
56' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) takes the corner but it's cleared.
55' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
48' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Odysseas Vlachodimos comes off the line to clear the ball away.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Ronald Araujo comes off for Eric Garcia (Barcelona).
46' Hansi Flick has made a change at the break. Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) has come on in place of Gerard Martin.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+7' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Pedri plays the ball to the feet of Marcus Rashford (Barcelona), who hits a tremendous first-time shot into the roof of the net. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 2:1.
45+5' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+3' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
44' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

44' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Odysseas Vlachodimos to get hold of the ball. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
40' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
38' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) was probably a bit loose with his words to Alejandro Ruiz, who decides to show him a yellow.
36' 2 - 0 Goal! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) scores after an assist by Ruben Vargas that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.
35' CHANCE! Alexis Sanchez finds Isaac Romero (Sevilla) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
33' The referee blows for a cooling break.
32' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) swings in a cross from the corner, but Odysseas Vlachodimos reads it well and gathers the ball.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.

29' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Batista Mendy (Sevilla) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the left side of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Wojciech Szczesny makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
28' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
28' Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a great save to deny Isaac Romero (Sevilla), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
24' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
21' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
20' Marcao (Sevilla) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
18' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
16' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
15' That's unlucky! Pedri (Barcelona) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
13' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Wojciech Szczesny no chance!
13' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) is going to take the penalty!
12' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Sevilla!

11' Play continues despite the shouts by some Sevilla players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
10' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
7' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball has crossed the sideline. Sevilla are taking a throw-in.
4' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
3' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' Half-chance! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) plays a pass into the box, but Wojciech Szczesny reacts well to snuff out the attack.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Barcelona will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Alejandro Ruiz.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text coverage. We will try to provide you with a detailed image of what's happening on the pitch. There are only few moments left to the beginning of the match.
